chapter: Topsy aftermath, Africa and later career
title: Records with guest drummers for Henry Jerome

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: And you also did a record with Henry Jerome and yourself and three other drummers.

Yeah, they were my guests on this album, It was Henry Jerome's idea and we did all commercial tunes, and each of us had a track. It was my guest on the albums were Gene Krupa, Ray McKinley and Panama Francis.
And that was done in '62 for Coral.

And you also did another record for Coral with Henry Jerome, well a couple of those tracks you redid 'Topsy' and you did 'Big Noise from Winnetka', they were on that cassette that I gave you last night. And that's the last thing that's listed in your discography in the early '60s. Let me just look over for a second. You had been recording under your own name since the early '40s with very small groups.
